name: desktop-session-scroll-jitter
title: Desktop session scroll jitter and history rendering issues
description: Track investigation of desktop session scroll jumps, history loading jitter, virtualized timeline overlap, and markdown lazy-render height changes causing viewport instability.
creator: claude-agent
notes: Cherry Studio scroll research added on 2026-04-02. Main takeaway: stability comes from a narrower scroll model with column-reverse, inverse infinite scroll, shallow per-topic scroll persistence, and fewer competing scroll owners. OpenCode simplification proposal added on 2026-04-02: one page-level scroll owner, remove turn-level auto-scroll from timeline usage, keep history slicing, disable main timeline virtualization for now, and move to event-driven live-follow plus a single anchor-based restore path. Detailed implementation plan added on 2026-04-02 with 7 ordered patches and verification matrix.
